from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class HousingDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """Extracted monthly housing statistics from a single report."""
    report_month: str | None = Field(description="The calendar month the data refers to, in YYYY-MM format")
    housing_starts: float | None = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted housing starts in thousands")
    housing_completions: float | None = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted housing completions in thousands")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this report was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format, used to resolve conflicts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_data_points: List[HousingDataPoint]
